Validation

Form Validation provides visual feedback and error messaging for user input. ZAKUIKit supports inline validation, validation states, and summary-based validation.

Validation States

Three validation states: success, error, and warning.

Email address is valid.
Please enter a valid email address.
This username may be confusing for other users.
HTML
<div class="zak-form-group">
  <label class="zak-form-label" for="email">Email</label>
  <input type="email" id="email"
    class="zak-input zak-form-control-success"
    value="john@example.com"
    aria-invalid="false">
  <span class="zak-form-text zak-text-success">Email address is valid.</span>
</div>

<div class="zak-form-group">
  <label class="zak-form-label" for="email">Email</label>
  <input type="email" id="email"
    class="zak-input zak-form-control-danger"
    value="not-an-email"
    aria-invalid="true"
    aria-describedby="email-error">
  <span class="zak-form-text zak-text-danger" id="email-error">
    Please enter a valid email address.
  </span>
</div>

Error Messages

Clear error messages below inputs with icons.

Name is required.
Please enter a valid email address.
Password must be at least 8 characters.
HTML
<div class="zak-form-group">
  <label class="zak-form-label zak-form-label-required" for="name">Name</label>
  <input type="text" id="name"
    class="zak-input zak-form-control-danger"
    aria-invalid="true"
    aria-describedby="name-error">
  <span class="zak-form-text zak-text-danger" id="name-error">
    <svg class="zak-icon zak-icon-sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><line x1="12" x2="12" y1="8" y2="12"/><line x1="12" x2="12.01" y1="16" y2="16"/>
    </svg>
    Name is required.
  </span>
</div>

Inline Validation

Validate fields as the user types using JavaScript.

Email is valid! Please enter a valid email.
HTML + JS
<input type="email" class="zak-input"
  oninput="validateInline(this, /^[^@]+@[^@]+\.[^@]+$/, 'valid', 'invalid')">
<span class="zak-form-text zak-text-success" id="valid" style="display:none;">Email is valid!</span>
<span class="zak-form-text zak-text-danger" id="invalid" style="display:none;">Please enter a valid email.</span>
JavaScript
function validateInline(input, regex, validId, invalidId) {
  const validEl = document.getElementById(validId);
  const invalidEl = document.getElementById(invalidId);
  const value = input.value.trim();
  if (!value) {
    validEl.style.display = 'none';
    invalidEl.style.display = 'none';
    input.classList.remove('zak-form-control-success', 'zak-form-control-danger');
    return;
  }
  if (regex.test(value)) {
    validEl.style.display = 'block';
    invalidEl.style.display = 'none';
    input.classList.add('zak-form-control-success');
    input.classList.remove('zak-form-control-danger');
  } else {
    validEl.style.display = 'none';
    invalidEl.style.display = 'block';
    input.classList.add('zak-form-control-danger');
    input.classList.remove('zak-form-control-success');
  }
}

Validation Summary

Display all validation errors in a summary block at the top of the form.

Please fix the following errors:
  • Name is required.
  • Email is invalid.
  • Password must be at least 8 characters.
HTML
<div class="zak-alert zak-alert-danger" role="alert">
  <strong>Please fix the following errors:</strong>
  <ul>
    <li>Name is required.</li>
    <li>Email is invalid.</li>
    <li>Password must be at least 8 characters.</li>
  </ul>
</div>

Custom Validation Patterns

Define regex patterns for custom field validation.

JavaScript
const patterns = {
  email: /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/,
  phone: /^\+?[\d\s-]{10,}$/,
  url: /^https?:\/\/.+\..+/,
  zip: /^\d{5}(-\d{4})?$/,
  username: /^[a-zA-Z0-9_]{3,20}$/,
  password: /^(?=.*[A-Za-z])(?=.*\d)(?=.*[@$!%*?&])[A-Za-z\d@$!%*?&]{8,}$/
};

function validateField(input, patternName) {
  const pattern = patterns[patternName];
  const value = input.value.trim();
  const isValid = pattern ? pattern.test(value) : value.length > 0;
  input.classList.toggle('zak-form-control-success', isValid && value.length > 0);
  input.classList.toggle('zak-form-control-danger', !isValid && value.length > 0);
  input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', !isValid ? 'true' : 'false');
  return isValid;
}

CSS Classes Reference

ClassDescription
.zak-form-control-successSuccess state on input
.zak-form-control-dangerError state on input
.zak-form-control-warningWarning state on input
.zak-text-successSuccess text
.zak-text-dangerError text
.zak-text-warningWarning text
.zak-form-textHelp/validation text

Accessibility

  • Use aria-invalid="true" on fields with errors.
  • Link error messages to inputs via aria-describedby.
  • Use role="alert" for validation summary blocks.
  • Use aria-live="polite" for inline validation messages that update dynamically.
  • Ensure error messages are programmatically associated, not just visually positioned.
  • Don't rely solely on color to indicate validation state — use icons and text as well.
